name: Gengar
notes: Painted design: dusky purple body with soft cloudy mottling, dark-red mouth interior, pink tongue, white teeth.

So: kept mostly smooth: the painted mottling as a very low, soft relief plus a fine velvety micro-grain (sub-texel, no bumps), rougher and less specular so it reads soft and gas-like, not plastic; tongue wetter; mouth and teeth untouched.
Body shader 2972460439 (material BodyA) has no normal sampler: in game only _dif and _par load; Body_nor is cache-only.
